Winshel Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Read more Deborah Winshel is a Senior Lecturer in the General Management Unit of Harvard Business School. She teaches several MBA required courses: Leadership and Organizational Behavior (LEAD), Leadership and Corporate Accountability and the Field Immersion course (2025 in South Korea). She teaches the MBA elective course, Power and Influence and has served as a faculty chair for first year MBA sections.
